name: keystone-sales-ops-bootstrap-admin

source.buildspec:
# One-time, manually started admin setup. Inline buildspec for a NO_SOURCE VPC job.
version: 0.2
env:
  shell: bash
phases:
  build:
    commands:
      - |
        set -euo pipefail
        : "${RELEASE_IMAGE:?Set the immutable ECR image URI}"
        : "${EXPECTED_IMAGE_DIGEST:?Set the SHA256 digest}"
        : "${EXPECTED_ECR_REPOSITORY_URI:?Configure the Sales Ops repository on this migration project}"
        : "${DATABASE_URL:?Configure the bootstrap database secret on the project}"
        : "${AWS_DEFAULT_REGION:?Set the AWS region}"
        [[ "$RELEASE_IMAGE" =~ ^[0-9]{12}\.dkr\.ecr\.[a-z0-9-]+\.amazonaws\.com/[a-z0-9._/-]+:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$ ]] || { echo "Invalid release image" >&2; exit 2; }
        [[ "$EXPECTED_IMAGE_DIGEST" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || { echo "Invalid image digest" >&2; exit 2; }
        [[ "${BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL:-}" == "yashraj@keystonecommerce.in" ]] || { echo "Unexpected bootstrap email" >&2; exit 2; }
        [[ "${BOOTSTRAP_ROLE:-}" == "admin" ]] || { echo "Bootstrap role must be admin" >&2; exit 2; }
        : "${BOOTSTRAP_NAME:?Set the initial administrator name}"
        registry="${RELEASE_IMAGE%%/*}"
        repository_uri="${RELEASE_IMAGE%:*}"
        [[ "$repository_uri" == "$EXPECTED_ECR_REPOSITORY_URI" ]] || { echo "Release image is outside the approved Sales Ops repository" >&2; exit 2; }
        aws ecr get-login-password --region "$AWS_DEFAULT_REGION" | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin "$registry"
        docker pull "$RELEASE_IMAGE"
        docker image inspect "$RELEASE_IMAGE" --format '{{json .RepoDigests}}' > /tmp/sales-ops-image-digests.json
        EXPECTED_REPO_DIGEST="${repository_uri}@${EXPECTED_IMAGE_DIGEST}" node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const digests=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("/tmp/sales-ops-image-digests.json","utf8"));if(!digests.includes(process.env.EXPECTED_REPO_DIGEST))throw Error("Release image digest does not match; refusing bootstrap");'
        docker run --rm \
          --env NODE_ENV=production \
          --env DATABASE_URL \
          --env DATABASE_CA_FILE=/app/certs/rds-ca.pem \
          --env DEV_EMBEDDED_DB=false \
          --env DEV_SEED=false \
          --env BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL \
          --env BOOTSTRAP_NAME \
          --env BOOTSTRAP_ROLE \
          "${repository_uri}@${EXPECTED_IMAGE_DIGEST}" node src/manage.js bootstrap-admin-once

description: Manually create the first Sales Ops admin once, after migrations. Not part of releases.
